svg.title: Two jobs: get the application onto session hosts, and decide what users see
svg.desc: Job 1: the application reaches the session hosts in the host pool in one of three ways: installed in the image, installed with Intune, or delivered with App Attach from an application package on an SMB file share, which session hosts read from. Job 2: users are assigned to an application group in a workspace. The application group is assigned to one host pool. With App Attach, the package is also assigned to users. Solid arrows go from what delivers or is assigned to its target. The dashed arrow goes from the reader to what it reads.
svg.text: Two jobs: get the application onto session hosts, and decide what users see
Job 1: get the application onto the session hosts
The application is installed in the image, so every session host
built from that image has it.
On Windows Enterprise multi-session session hosts: system context,
targeted to devices, Required or Uninstall intent.
The application is not installed on the session host or in the image.
The application package is assigned to the host pool and to users.
